set.title: Item tool: instant read, query and CRUD of ANY item (session, task, page, any Item) by path
set.expected: item({path}) instantiates the item server-side, replays its lines and answers its state at once; item({path, delta}) runs a method or sets fields and saves; the same for pages (today it builds nothing for a page) and every Item subclass. Asking about a session (its tasks, completion, cost, duration, child sessions) is one item call, never reading raw JSONL or asking an agent. Tests prove it for Session, Task, Page. Any gap the owner would hit is listed in the plan.
set.description: The owner's shape: tools are just methods on the item. The server holds the instance in memory, runs the method (set, save, query, do), saves properly and responds. One system for everything.

A getter-only field inside a child add (commits, cost, completion) is refused by name. Add one test to item_tool.test.mjs. Same branch as subtask 4.

findings.text: reviewer failed to run: The operation was aborted due to timeout

Subtask 4, last bullet: the brief said to call the unused `js_children` helper (`Subpages.js:107-114`). The branch deletes it instead, and changes the stale test so it checks that the child is noted in the parent's `page.jsonl` and `page.js` is left untouched. The ask's core (a `page.js` parent gets its child noted) is met, and the reason (a page.js is code and is never edited, 17c696fa6, 645ccbe33) is written in `Servex/doc/item-tool.md`. The mastermind should confirm this departure from the brief at merge — diff.patch, `Servex/agents/page_tools.test.mjs` hunk.

`page_class()` ends in `.catch(() => null)`, and `page_refusal` then returns null. If `Page.class.js` ever fails to import in node, every page line is written unchecked and nothing logs why. One warning line would make that visible — diff.patch, `page_tools.js` `page_class`.

`page_refusal` re-parses and replays the whole `page.jsonl` on every page write (`Page.replay([...parse_lines(at.file), …])`). The cost grows with the file, so a session page with thousands of lines pays it on every `page_add`. Task files keep a live root; page files could do the same later — diff.patch, `page_tools.js` `page_refusal`.
The new doc section is dated 2026-10-24 ("A real Page, and lines refused before they are written"), but the work is from 2026-10-23 — `Servex/doc/item-tool.md`.
The handoff checks in `item_tool.test.mjs` are now skipped when `Servex/node_modules` is missing (in a worktree). The test prints a line when it skips, but its pass count then varies by tree.
There was already a problem on the navigation page, and this diff does not cause it: the tab bar wraps to 3 rows at 1200 (navigation 14) — layout.json tab_rows 3 at 1200, 2 at 1920.
